<b>Ruined Tool</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be brought to one of three places to be permanently repaired into a variant of the [[Silkshot]].

== Use ==
The Ruined Tool can be repaired and crafted into one of the three different variants of the [[Silkshot]], with each variant having unique stats and attributes depending on who repairs it. Once repaired, the other variants are unobtainable.

== How to Acquire ==
The Ruined Tool can be found in [[Weavenest Murglin]], behind a [[Needolin]] door in the southeastern corner of [[Bilewater]]. Bilewater can be entered through a breakable wall connected to eastern [[Sinner's Road]], allowing the Ruined Tool to be obtainable in [[Act 1]].
